title: Pocket4 Android: native, signal and pressure fixes with actual acceptance evidence
body:
## Checkpoint 19 — app fixes preserved; framework recovery remains open

Published commit `be6f2e4de9df1cc8077efacc37aae7311f1d1ef0`, parent `80e030d93be61d89550d8d3493d9eb60ddff45a2`. The immutable evidence cut is **2026-11-06 05:14:25 UTC**. **Whole-app production-ready: 0/45. Work remains active.**

The old zygote and system_server identities disappeared while the original daemon, init, launcher, presenter and surfaceflinger identities survived the bounded checks. Newly observed framework processes are not yet a qualified QA epoch. New UI and install admissions remain blocked pending complete identity and helper-protocol rebinding; the exit cause is not established by this checkpoint.

- **Bilibili:** R8 static build and 54 controls passed, and its historical install bound UID 10204. The UI attempt failed at the old Main guard before creating the owned stage or attempting an Android action; separate fixed-path checks observed both paths absent. The runtime idle fix remains unobserved.
- **IHG:** 70 controls passed. Search was rejected by the helper before the click because its final tree/window guard changed. Destination never started; the flow's unknown outcome is preserved. The independent post inspection completed and the owned task retired. The new stability candidate remains source-only with 89 unrun controls.
- **Amazon and BestBuy:** Amazon R2 built with 54 controls but has no install/UI result. BestBuy's historical read-only flow passed; nine visible nodes exposed no actionable public roles. Neither visual blankness nor the old depth-33 path is qualified.
- **Android service diagnosis:** BuildId-matched LMKD instructions identify the nonpositive SDK property-getter branch. Both fixed build.prop files contain `37.0`; runtime property visibility remains unresolved. Owner20's dependency reader passed; its accessor is not compiled or run at this cut.
- **Native build repair:** The source candidate retains both strict normal targets and all original failing consumers. Its 491-file builder map covers 224 locked projects, 24 full Blueprint fixtures and 59 exact upstream provider stanzas. Compile02 and Soong/Java/JNI qualification remain unrun.
- **Preservation:** All 12,370 inherited rows and 217,054,264 bytes remain exact. This checkpoint adds 500 files / 9,674,672 bytes across 78 explicitly reviewed trees plus metadata. Full manifests, all new leaf paths and directory hashes, and changed ancestor trees were independently verified. Private crash packets and raw App UI remain excluded.

## Checkpoint 18 — actual recovery evidence and remaining failures

Published from CP17 `54b59ea75380060d4ad8643581bdd779f333c332` to `80e030d93be61d89550d8d3493d9eb60ddff45a2`. The immutable primary snapshot is **2026-11-06 03:37:05 UTC**, with the explicitly authorized diagnostic addendum at **03:42:50 UTC**. **Whole-app production-ready: 0/45. Work remains active.**

- Preserve all 11,939 inherited records and their original bytes; append 431 source/evidence files (8,863,667 bytes) under 67 reviewed package trees. Total payload: 12,370 files / 217,054,264 bytes. The full manifest, actual payload tree, and every changed ancestor were independently read back and verified; unrelated trees remain identical.
- Owner19 still fails before ACTIVE. Its bounded collector captured 257 complete packets, and exact retirement completed. Only safe diagnostic derivatives are published; the two observed initialization stack families do not establish the exact abort cause.
- The prior strict native Java/JNI build fails at the Soong dependency graph after all 214 projects synchronized. Original terminal records, build logs, and cleanup evidence are retained. Builder468 is unrun at this cut and still has known dependency closure gaps; missing dependencies remain disallowed.
- BestBuy R2 build and helper installation passed; fresh deep-tree UI validation was unrun at this cut. Bilibili R7 and Amazon05 failures remain recorded. Amazon's nine attribution controls and IHG's 51 destination controls passed; IHG's fresh destination result was unreviewed at the cut. Bilibili R8 was source-only at the cut.
- No Main deployment, restart, or reload. This checkpoint preserves the 12,288 pids baseline. Source, build, or narrow control success does not qualify a whole app.

Root verification tree: `b720073a8f1f75c756da66ab6eb0f5dacaa2ca58`. Full delivery manifest: `c7035a2e7dd8091d38f21986770a22f743a2cd38` / SHA256 `7e6bf53d4b299bbf2a7bd05efc742a2a1439ed7ebca1a2b4de291225ab33a628`.

## Current checkpoint 17 — repairs and actual acceptance continue

**Whole-App production readiness remains 0/45.** This draft preserves a fixed primary evidence cut at **2026-11-06 01:20:18 UTC**, with an explicitly bounded addendum at **01:27:34 UTC**. Later runtime outcomes are not retroactively included. No Main engine or supervisor deployment or restart is included.

This checkpoint adds **2,558 verified text payloads / 45,232,539 bytes** and retains all **9,381 prior payload rows unchanged and in order**. The delivery manifest now binds **11,939 payloads / 208,190,597 bytes**, excluding itself. Every candidate payload was independently hashed before the local environment became unavailable; the full immutable Git trees, all directory hashes, and the complete new and prior manifests were then verified without that environment.

- **Native source recovery:** compile03 actually passed 56 commands and 18 focused controls. The normal strict two-target framework resume is recorded only through its actual admission at this cut; successful build, final source reuse, and runtime integration are not asserted.
- **Owner18:** preserve the actual failure before ACTIVE, precise owned retirement and cleanup, and the bounded logd metadata diagnosis. Private captured bytes are excluded; this does not qualify Owner production readiness.
- **Bili:** preserve the earlier failed pause action and independent restoration evidence. R7 static build passed. The addendum includes the install admission only, with no inference of later install or playback success.
- **IHG:** public Search selected-state passed with owned task retirement. Destination entry, hotel results, booking, and whole-App readiness remain unverified.
- **BestBuy:** readiness failed at the original complete-tree depth bound. The partial third tree is not accepted. Original Main checks and exact task cleanup remain recorded.
- **Amazon and Ticket:** preserve actual failures before the attempted UI work where the original lock was not acquired; these are not relabeled as business or App success.

The original failed and unresolved attempts remain preserved. Git preservation recovery also retains its original timeout/unknown and response-saving failures; the final verified tree is not used to rewrite those outcomes.

**Reviewable source and evidence:** `compat/android/pocket4/continuation-r11/checkpoint17/`. Final immutable candidate tree: `d28deed485cdfff7aa8335e7064c63f2979bc02c`. Independent Git verification receipt tree: `970db8b5d12d903209c36c320a65ef9932d9027e`.

Its SHA256 is `a64380d8b942448f5e97955a7bb5eadd16e59a4e1c5e03f520029e248ceb50c4`.

- **Candidate07:** four isolated Android SVC/SMC cases passed against the exact engine, with all 16 original case files and exact cleanup read back. The controller's 61,356 memory.max events remain recorded separately from the services' zero events. Metadata generation and full-App qualification remain disabled/unqualified.
- **Builder462:** matching actual compile, 24 focused tests, and five real image controls passed in 57 commands. There are 197 registered tests; this is not a claim that all 197 executed. Enabled ART lifecycle, Soong, and platform APEX signatures remain unqualified.
- **Producer11 / Owner11:** diagnostic preservation is fixed and passed actual compile plus 30 relay / 122 supervisor / 7 IPC tests. Fresh Owner11 still failed before ACTIVE. Original Owner retirement was incomplete; later outer exact cleanup succeeded with Main unchanged. A nonce/generation/cgroup-bound original diagnostic now identifies an ENOENT in a pinned-relative-directory operation. The exact relative name and phase are not yet observed; no speculative attribution to blkio, cpuset, or unrelated kernel logs is made.
- **Bilibili R5:** actual installation03 and the public search/course path passed. The repaired structural predicate admitted the two actual SurfaceViews. Two qualified private crops visibly rendered lecture content; a third detected a 320-pixel window shift and failed the unchanged scope gate. Preserve the failed run. Continuous playback, controls, lifecycle, renderer attribution, and App-attributed audio are still pending.
- **Amazon:** dedicated helper actual build/sign/install and one no-UiAutomation state read passed. Actual UID 10175; exactly 13 commands, state at command eight. Three commercial APKs and Main stayed unchanged; staging, held FDs, and the action lock were released. Public UI/business acceptance is next.
- **Native factory/ART:** fixed source reads, the native-only FS query candidate, and a separate role authorization protocol are preserved with explicit limitations. Local receive controls passed; root-parent positive grants, fork lifecycle, early policy, JNI/ART/APEX integration, and enablement are not qualified.

Current details: [checkpoint14/status.json](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/trillionnium-os-desktop/blob/9e6bed241bcbf20986f505dbc0a5c70d211d6ab5/compat/android/pocket4/continuation-r11/checkpoint14/status.json), [checkpoint14/README.md](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/trillionnium-os-desktop/blob/9e6bed241bcbf20986f505dbc0a5c70d211d6ab5/compat/android/pocket4/continuation-r11/checkpoint14/README.md). Original failures and uncertain-acknowledgement recovery remain preserved. Private pixels, commercial UI trees, APK/ELF binaries, keys, caches, and unrelated metadata are excluded.

The next work is the strict Owner terminal-receipt drain, precise failure provenance, fresh pre-capture Bilibili observations, Amazon public flow, and matched factory-role positive/fork qualification. No checkpoint stops the remaining work.

- **Native engine:** candidate06's original full-build failure is preserved at host `linux/memfd.h`. - **Separate unfinished sources:** coherent LMKD property reinitialization, PROCMET2 updater/ART pairing and prefork ordering remain distinct gates. No source-only candidate is represented as a runtime PASS.
